main_text.l: venire audiuisset à Persarum rege legatos Byzan-
tium, in vrbem rediit regiam. Tertia verò post die
Celtiberiæ eodem quoq; Legati veniunt. Legatis
nomina erant Bofo ac Betto, quos princeps gentis
(Franci hi recentiore lingua vocantur. at illi no-
men Theodoricho) ad Imperatorem misit, pro-
misitq;, sc,si[?] vectigalia sibi darentur, opitulaturum
Romanis, ac pro muneribus cum Chagano gestu-
rum bellum. Imperator tamen muneratus legatos,
si sua auxilia subpeditarent Franci, vt id gratis fa-
cerent iussit, nequaquam emi passus à Romanis o-
pem barbarorum. Interim Chaganus ad priora pa-
cta additamentum ab Imperatore flagitat, in qua
re barbarus non auditus, statim restaurauit bellum.
XIII.
Qvod Prifcus quindecim valla metatus, traiec-
to Istro fluuio, quarta die superiores Nobas venit.
quod cum refcifceret Chaganus, ad Prifcum lega-
tos misit, caufamque scire voluit aduentus Roma-
norum. Refpondit dux, ad venationem & aequi-
tatum esse loca idonea, & aquosa satis: cui Chaga-
nus oftendit alienam terram calcare Romanos,
citraque pactum agere Priscum, & aperte pacem
ab eo conuelli. Refpondet Priicus[?], Romanum
quoque tu subis solum. Chaganus, armis, inquit, &
iure belli. Romanos hoc amisisse. Chagano am-
plius rixante & difceptante de his locis, Priscum
fugam ex oriente exprobrasse dicunt Chagano. In-
stante namque aestate Chaganus, qui laudibus,
à Turcis in oriente celebratur, legatos miserat ad

page.notes: Left margin: only cropped fragments of marginal notes remain along the left edge (about a dozen short fragments, e.g. at the heights of the first, second and sixth lines); they are too cut off to read and are not transcribed. Doubtful readings: "sc,si" (possibly "fc,fi"), "Celtiberiæ", "Priicus" (apparent printing error for Priscus, left as printed), "traiecto" (the "ct" ligature is partly obscured). Catchword "stola" is only partly legible, read from "stcla" at the foot right. Heading "XIII." is a bare number and is therefore a paragraph, not a heading. The text ends with a hyphenated word "epi-", continued on the next page.
